  • Specific appearance

Pheochromocytoma #13

  • primary

  • neuroblastoma - children – ill defined, heterogeneous, calcif.

  • 4th location (Lu, Li, Bo)
  • From Lung, breast, NHL, melanoma

Lymph nodes #18

  • Nodal groups - normal size, transverse diameter
  • Retrocrural (n<6 mm)

  • Pelvic (n<12 mm)
  • diseased = enlarged in:

  • sarcoidosis, TBC, HIV, mesenteric adenitis.

Lymphadenopathy= enlarged lymph nodes #19

  • Semeiology:
  • Nodular masses,
  • Multiple,
  • Perivascular,
  • Abnormal increased size and number
  • Hypoechoic, isodense

Computed tomography #35

  • Dgs. Tumors with fat / calcification: dermoid cyst/teratoma

  • Ovarian cancer staging

  • CT thorax + abdomen + contrast = quick, accessible for visceral, nodal or bone metastasis
  • Peritoneal carcinomatosis / epiploic tumor thickening

CT Anatomy #36

  • Uterus:
  • Myometrium – high vascularization – enhancing p.c.
  • Collection in the endometrium - hypodense (fluid) or hyperdense (blood)
  • Ovaries:
  • Frequently not seen
  • Folicles help detecting the area
  • Folicular cysts – hypodense, fluid
  • Normal fallopian tubes – not seen

Imagine din mijloc - CT nu deceleaza structura uterina. Imagine din dreapta - Post contrast miometrul capteaza - hiperdens.

CT anatomy #38

Pelvic MRI #39

  • Local / regional staging of malignancies - accurately identify patients who need neoadjuvant therapy
  • Monitoring - during & posttherapy
  • High sensitivity in:
  • Congenital anomalies
  • Endometriosis
  • Complex pelvic inflamation

MRI – uterine anatomy #40

  • Best of all for structure
  • T2 the most useful
  • T1 useless for structure (diffuse hyposignal)
  • Post contrast T1 shows the structure

MRI – uterine anatomy #41

  • Endometrium – hypersignal on T2
  • Junctional zone (transition endometrium – myometrium) – linear hyposignal T2
  • Myometrium – intermediate signal T2
  • Uterine cervix + vagina - hyposignal;

MR – ovarian anatomy #42

  • In fertile females – follicles
  • Follicles – fluid signal – hypo T1 , hyper T2
  • Premenopause – cortex (hypo) separate from medulla (intermediate)
  • Postmenopause – same signal

  • Sagittal T2
  • Coronal T2

MRI –anatomy #44

Hysterosalpingography #45

  • Infertile pts.
  • Anomalies / tubal obstruction
  • Functional information – tubal peristalsis
  • Assess uterine cavity and fallopian tubes
  • Cannulation of uterine cervix + injection of iodinated lyposoluble c.m.
  • Tubar patency confirmed by c.m. in the peritoneal cavity

Hysterosalpyngography #46

Benign – congenital anomalies #50

Benign tumors –leiomyoma (fibroid) #53

  • The most frequent myometrial tumor

Benign tumors –leiomyoma (fibroid) #54

hypoechoic, well delineated #55

  • Leiomyoma: US

CT is NOT used to characterize leiomyomas (incidental findings) #56

  • MR – location, size, no.
  • Usually Hypo T1 &T2
  • Necrosis, Liquefaction
  • NOT used routinely
  • Preoperative assessment
  • Leiomyoma: CT & MRI

Benign tumors – fibroma (leiomyoma) #57

  • Examinarea RM descrie exact localizarea, dimensiunea si numarul fibroamelor
  • De obicei sunt in hiposemnal fata de miometru pe secventele T1 si T2; morfologia lor este bine apreciata pe T2
  • Prezinta priza de contrast mai redusa decat miometrul
  • Devin inomogene in caz de degenerescenta lichidiana, calcifieri sau zone hemoragice incluse

Leiomyoma: MRI #58

Notes: Formatiuni tumorale uterine, localizate la nivelul miometrului (pastrarea integritatii zonei jonctionale - hiposemnal), inomogen structurate, cu zone de degenerescente lichidiana inclusa. Formatiunea nu intereseaza colul uterin (imagine sagitala).

Leiomyoma: MRI #59

Notes: Formatiuni tumorale uterine, localizate la nivelul miometrului (pastrarea integritatii zonei jonctionale - hiposemnal), inomogen structurate, cu zone de degenerescente lichidiana inclusa. Formatiunea nu intereseaza colul uterin (imagine sagitala).

Endometrial thickening #60

  • Coronal T2
  • Sagital T2

Notes: Prima imagine (din stanga) – In regiunea fundica uterine, se evidentiaza o formatiune nodulara in hiposemnal T2 cu efect de masa asupra cavitatii endometriale. Formatiunea descrisa subtiaza miometrul adiacent, nu intrerupe seroasa uterine. Aspectul descris pledeaza pentru un polip endometrial (nu se poate exclude un fibrom subseros). Imaginea din mijloc – Ectazia canalului endometrial cu continut difuz, inomogen. Zona jonctionala dintre endometru si miometru este pastrata. Aspectul descris pledeaza pentru hiperplazie endometriala. Imaginea din dreapta - ingrosarea focala a zonei de jonctiune cu o masa nodulara inomogena T2 – aspect de adenomioza focala.

Endometrial cancer: first diagnosis #61

  • Postmenopausal woman + uterine bleeding
  • (90% of cases)
  • Transvaginal Ultrasound (endometrial thickness >3-4 mm)
  • Transvaginal US
  • Transvaginal US:
  • Thickened endometrum
  • N. Colombo, E. Preti, F. Landoni, S. Carinelli, A. Colombo, C. Marini, C. Sessa, on behalf of the ESMO Guidelines Working Group; Endometrial cancer: ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for diagnosis, treatment and follow-up. Ann Oncol 2013; 24 (suppl_6): vi33-vi38. doi: 10.1093/annonc/mdt353
  • Curettage/endometrial biopsy
  • Transabdominal US

Slide 62 #62

  • - Evaluation of the depth of myometrial invasion to predict the likehood of advanced disease (incidence of lymph node metastases is < 2.5% in stage IA vs. 15-45% in stage IB*)
  • - Diagnosis of gross cervical invasion, which requires preoperative radiation therapy or a different treatment plan (radical histerectomy instead of total abdominal histectomy)
  • - Identification of suspicious lymph nodes to guide lymph node sampling at the time of surgery
  • - Detection of advanced disease
  • Staging : the role of preoperative imaging
  • *Lalwany N, Dubinsky T, Javitt MC, Gaffney DK, Glank P, et al. ACR Appropriateness criteria – pretreatment evaluation andf ollow-up of endometrial cancer. Ultrasound Quarterly; 2014 Mar;30(1):21-28
  • FIGO

Malignant – endometrial cancer #68

  • MR – best method for staging
  • Compared to myometrium – isosignal T1 and hypersignal T2
  • Late enhancement
  • On T2 – disrupts the junctional zone
  • CT + PET-CT – for distal metastases and recurrence

Initial diagnosis: benign vs malignant #79

  • Froyman W, Timmerman D. Methods of assessing ovarian masses: international ovarian tumor analysis approach. Obstetrics and Gynecology Clinics. 2019 Dec 1;46(4):625-41.
  • Simple Rules
  • 5 benignity criteria(B)
  • 5 malignancy criteria(M)
  • If one M criterion present = malignant
  • Se= 95 %

Zonal anatomy #103

  • 3 main zones:
  • peripheral (ZP) (70%)
  • Central (ZC)(25%)
  • Transitional (ZT)(5%)
  • SFA – fibromuscular stroma–
  • Ejaculatory ducts (DE) open in prostatic urethra at the level of Verum montanum (V)

Notes: Nu se mai utilizeaza anatomia descriptiva veche ci anatomia zonala lui McNeal Procente – cat la suta din volumul prostatic

Prostate US #104

Transrectal US #105

  • Differentiate anatomical areas
  • Complex analysis – morphology + vascularization (Doppler) + stiffness (elasto) + microvascularization (CEUS).

Prostate cancer (PCa) #112

  • Most common malignancy in males
  • Due to PSA, most cancers are detected early, high survival rate
  • 70% of the cases in the peripheral zone
  • Screening = clinical exam + PSA
  • Staging = MRI +/- CT
  • Diagnosis = pathology (transrectal biopsy)
